notes.title: The Survival Patch
notes.notes:
[b]The Survival Patch (2.5.3)[/b]

Sorry Steam players for no updates! But get ready for this one.

The following patch notes are a compilation from versions 2.5.1 and 2.5.2 and 2.5.3!


[list]
[*] [b]HORROR IS BACK IN FOREST AS SURVIVAL! A NEW GAMEMODE! [/b](Horror as a map is still there!)
[*] Added animations to Jansell (Shop Keeper)
[*] Friends List now only shows 5 friends per page for readability
[*] [b]Spring is here and the snow has melted… The maps are back to its beautiful greenery![/b]
[*] [b]Added Main Menu[/b]
[*] Added Emoticons
[*] Added Community Voting (We will arrange voting topics)
[*] Added Silver Tier Mod Menu now for sale in Mall for $11.99
[*] Added 4 New Cosmetics (Mohawk, Pirate, Jumpsuit, JetPack)
[*] Mod Menus now become discounted by 20% when you own one (1) or more
[*] Color is now randomized for new players (No longer 0, 0, 0)
[*] Improved Anticheat (All modded APKs are invalid)
[*] Randomize Cosmetics button added to Lockers
[*] Invisible colliders in Horror fixed
[*] Fixed Log system so its actually readable and doesn’t just spam stuff
[*] Music on Speakers now play when you load in and aren’t muted by default
[/list]

JOIN THE DISCORD FOR MORE INFORMATION ON THE GAME AND TO CHAT!
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/AhNp6vPmrv]https://discord.gg/AhNp6vPmrv[/url]
